documents.text: To enable single sign on, go to Settings, then Security, then Identity Providers. Upload your IdP metadata XML. Assign the SSO role to the admin group before enforcing login.
After configuring the identity provider, enforce SSO for all users from the Security page. Test with a single user first. Keep one break glass admin account with password login.
